11.t: (a) The Game cost can be from 1 to 9 coins per credit.
(b) The half price to continue rounds up to the nearest whole number. (For example, 3 to start, 2 to continue: or 4 to start, 2 to continue).
(c) The number of logical coins per physical coin can be adjusted from 1 to 9.
(d) The attract sound can be turned “ON” or “OFF” (we suggest “ON”).
(e) The “ADS MODE” (bookkeeping) option can be removed from the Main Test Menu by selecting “OFF”. No bookkeeping will be kept if this option is “OFF”
(f) The Shield damage level can be adjusted between 1 (easy) and 8 (hard).
(g) The difficulty (Rank) can be adjusted between “A” (easy) and “D” (hard).
NOTE: Adjusting the Shield Damage (f) is more effective than adjusting the Rank (g).
(h) The Free Play option can be turned “ON” or “OFF”. The games will be tracked in the bookeeping as if they were paid games.
